design_limits: No final UN assignment and no final PG, even when the candidate PG is numeric.
O.1/O.3 require all three comparator sets as conservative simplifying evidence condition; if partial comparators are available, return insufficient evidence rather than infer an unverified weaker PG.
Fertilizer Figure 39.1 full composition-to-exit computation is not implemented; requires audited external flowchart record and exit/outcome consistency checks.
No machine authentication of reports, laboratory competence, source images, test setup or competent-authority signatures.
Generic prohibitedIdentity flag is a manually attested fallback; no exhaustive substance identity ontology implemented.
No complete chemical-incompatibility engine, package compatibility, stabilization recipes or ADR 2025 Table A rows.
No inferred negative competing hazards from absent SDS data; all results blocked for assignment.
